maya: Heads-up — planning convo: long-term platform routing + multi-tenant isolation roadmap. Need alignment on launch criteria for 'isolation lanes' by EOW.

devon: From infra: blockers are routing policy DSL maturity + per-tenant telemetry. P0 acceptance: deterministic fallback (no data-cross), per-tenant affinity, clear SLOs.

nate: Customer ask: large regulated customer requires strict VPC + geo-residency and NO automatic cross-region fallback. They will sign only if we have legally auditable routing rules.

sophia: So acceptance checklist idea:

```
- Perf: P99 < 200ms for 512 tokens in dedicated lane
- Reliability: canary 2% traffic, 2 weeks, error budget < 5% burn
- Security: VPC + KMS integration verified
- Residency: routing rules enforce region-set, no auto-evac across borders
- Ops: rollback and evacuation playbook + runbook tested
- Billing: reserved capacity pricing and meterable per-tenant usage
- Quality: eval set regression < 1% change in top prompts
```

devon: +1. Add: telemetry gaps — need per-request tenant id in tracing, prefix-cache hit metrics, and per-tenant tail latencies.

eva: :thumbsup: Also exportable eval set & test harness for customers. We'll need a way to replay traffic slices.
